b_01KZCB22FZT1HT4WJ1F6ZQE84M.content: For Addition-type jobs, the AI's schedule-generation role is narrowly scoped to three per-item decisions (include/exclude/needs_info, crew size, duration) against a fixed versioned task_structure.json topology — it must never invent tasks, author dependencies, or reorder phases.

b_01KZCB22FZQPAMW7T1ERZFWJE2.subject: addition_known_variance_traps
b_01KZCB22FZQPAMW7T1ERZFWJE2.content: Six job attributes must never be silently guessed on an addition — septic vs. city sewer, trusses vs. stick-frame, stairs/second-floor access method, carpet vs. hard flooring, shower glass vs. curtain, and mini-split vs. ducted HVAC — each requires needs_info when scope doesn't state it explicitly.
b_01KZCB22FZQPAMW7T1ERZFWJE2.falsification_test: A future structure revision removing any of these six from the mandatory needs_info list would falsify this.

b_01KZCBDD45EMEHX9HCWGQVS0X0.content: Interior-phase work on an addition is gated on ROOFING completion specifically, not on full exterior finish completion — siding, fascia/soffit/gutters, and vent extensions run in parallel outside once roofing is done, and job completion (not interior start) waits for all of them.
b_01KZCBDD45EMEHX9HCWGQVS0X0.falsification_test: A future structure revision that gates interior start on full exterior finish (rather than roofing alone) would falsify this.

b_01KZCBDD468KQ27NENTMWR63K3.content: Rock excavation, concealed roof tie-in conditions, and year-one drywall cracking at tie-ins are pre-identified, routine carve-outs on additions — the first two default to change orders, the third defaults to warranty work — and none should be baked into the base schedule or estimate as padding.
b_01KZCBDD468KQ27NENTMWR63K3.falsification_test: A future job_definition revision that requires these to be pre-priced into the base estimate rather than handled as change order/warranty would falsify this.
